say:0:1010627001:0.text: May I stay a little longer to study your magic, Magister Merlin?
say:0:1010627001:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，可以允许我留在这里研究你的法阵吗？
say:0:1010627001:0.male: May I stay a little longer to study your magic, Magister Merlin?
say:0:1010627001:0.female: May I stay a little longer to study your magic, Magister Merlin?

say:1:1010627002:0.text: I must lovingly sketch out every detail in my sketchbook!
say:1:1010627002:0.source_cn: 如此简洁，却如此优雅完美！我要一笔一画描摹到笔记上！
say:1:1010627002:0.male: I must lovingly sketch out every detail in my sketchbook!
say:1:1010627002:0.female: I must lovingly sketch out every detail in my sketchbook!

say:2:1010627003:0.text: Heh, you reminded me of my old "Merlin Magical Research Club".
say:2:1010627003:0.source_cn: 呵呵，你让我想到曾经的“梅林秘仪暨魔法研究会”呢。
say:2:1010627003:0.male: Heh, you reminded me of my old "Merlin Magical Research Club".
say:2:1010627003:0.female: Heh, you reminded me of my old "Merlin Magical Research Club".

say:3:1010627004:0.text: The "Merlin Magical Research Club?" Tell me all about it!
say:3:1010627004:0.source_cn: ——“梅林研究会”？请务必和我说说！
say:3:1010627004:0.male: The "Merlin Magical Research Club?" Tell me all about it!
say:3:1010627004:0.female: The "Merlin Magical Research Club?" Tell me all about it!

say:4:1010627005:0.text: ... if you're Merlin's student, that makes you my upperclassman.
say:4:1010627005:0.source_cn: 对了，您既然是梅林大人曾经的学生，我是否可以叫您“学姐”呢？
say:4:1010627005:0.male: ... if you're Merlin's student, that makes you my upperclassman.
say:4:1010627005:0.female: ... if you're Merlin's student, that makes you my upperclassman.
